n, coinsAvailable = map(int, input().split())
vals = list(map(int, input().split()))
oddCount = 0
evenCount = 0
result = 0
diffList = []

for i in range(n - 1):
    val = vals[i]
    if val % 2 == 0:
        evenCount += 1
    else:
        oddCount += 1
    if oddCount == evenCount:
        nextVal = vals[i + 1]
        diff = abs(nextVal - val)
        diffList.append(diff)

diffList.sort()

for diff in diffList:
    if diff <= coinsAvailable:
        coinsAvailable -= diff
        result += 1
    else:
        break

print(result)
</translated_code>
